_comment: Model configuration used in every experiment. Parameters that are not listed keep the library default of the versions in requirements.txt. No early stopping, no resampling.

preprocessing.missing_values: none in the file; no imputation
preprocessing.logistic_regression_only: log1p on the six topological features, then StandardScaler fitted on the training partition

XGB_weighted.scale_pos_weight: number of negative training records / number of positive training records

threshold_calibration.rule: threshold = 99th percentile of the scores of white validation records; a record is flagged when its score is strictly greater than the threshold, so that the validation false-positive rate cannot exceed 1% when scores are tied

bootstrap.combined_protocol: 500 resamples per seed, replicates pooled over the three seeds
bootstrap.withheld_family: 1000 resamples per seed, replicates pooled over the five seeds

drift.statistic: two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov per topological feature, averaged
drift.classifier_two_sample_test: LightGBM (model configuration above), 3-fold cross-validated ROC-AUC, reference versus test records
